rules.class: baseline-only|template-only|active-only when present in one set; identical when present in two or more sets with one blob id; differing otherwise
rules.key: path relative to the .claude directory of each set
rules.origin: generated when the template set holds the path, else source
rules.scope: private when the file name contains .local. or ends with .local, else shared
rules.tracking: current checkout: tracked (ls-files), ignored (check-ignore), untracked, or absent
